custom_logic_notes: AbsolutelyNoLagLwma is a zero-lag weighted moving average that applies a correction algorithm to eliminate standard LWMA lag. NN3 is a 3-layer neural network that takes the filtered LWMA directional components as inputs and produces a composite buy/sell signal. MMRec module recommends position size based on account equity, risk tolerance, and current stop distance. Digit adjustment multiplies SL/TP by 10 for 5-digit brokers (_Digits==5 or _Point<0.001).
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of AbsolutelyNoLagLwma zero-lag LWMA algorithm in Python (use numpy convolve with corrected weights or ta library custom wrapper). NN3 neural network layer weights must be extracted from the .mqh include or trained from scratch using historical data. MMRec money management can be replicated with a simple risk-based lot sizing function. Digit adjustment logic is straightforward: multiply pip values by 10 when price has 5 decimal places. The EA processes on new bar only (OnTick with new bar guard), making bar-based backtesting in Python viable. All indicator values reference previous completed bar (shift=1), so no lookahead bias concerns.
